notes: Daily report to share, Holy Mass or No Mass days set by the priest, and a way to ask the priest when today is not confirmed.
new: Daily report: when all tasks are done, the app offers to share a text report to Messenger or any chat, so the admin and priest can see what the crew did.
The priest, founder and admin can choose which days have Holy Mass. The crew gets a notification when the days change.
A Holy Mass today card on Home tells everyone if there is Holy Mass today. When it is not confirmed, the crew gets a pop-up to notify the priest, and the priest and admin get a notification.
changed: A day set by the priest now controls the Chapel tasks for that day, and the Holy Mass today selector is locked for it.
